task.description: Restore complete four-event service from a node with uncertain effective beam length. Local repair may change downstream electrical loading.

spec.acquisition: 128 points at 2048Hz, actual ADC and spectral confirmation
spec.main_beam: 10mm wide steel/PZT bimorph, .15mm substrate and .12mm layers,4.65g tip mass
spec.aux_beam: 6mm wide, .10mm substrate/.08mm PZT layers,.14g tip mass
spec.circuit: Diode rectifier; auxiliary voltage can enter RC envelope detector; comparator can gate MCU; otherwise MCU polls at100ms. Installed auxiliary beam and RC loads participate in coupled ODE.
spec.primitive_cost: Additional beam has mechanical response and input loading; envelope has2nF capacitance,100kohm charge path,20Mohm bleed; no free constructed delivery bit.
spec.uncertainty: The device has an unmeasured effective-length variation in one beam due to fabrication or mounting. Knobs are nominal lengths; power/trigger/program measurements reveal realized behavior. Variation is unchanged during a trajectory.

task.diagnostic: A failed design may originate at mechanical input, stored supply, analog observation or digital execution; terminal delivery alone does not identify the cause.

domain_change.reason: Authorized one fallback after C80 trigger-only repair passed4/4. C50 is a public initial value and bound, not a hidden consumer modification.

qualification_conclusion.C80: Trigger-only repair passes4/4; not load-pull witness.
qualification_conclusion.claim_boundary: One fixed point in the unchanged four-event consumer. Trigger repair activates actual digital load; C150 joint pass is reused exact original qualification. Does not prove local/global impossibility or that an Agent must repair in multiple iterations.

load_pull_witness_summary.interpretation: Initial voltage exceeds the start threshold but cannot be interpreted as sufficient burst energy. Trigger-only repair activates original digital loads and exhausts C50 during sampling; SAVE/TX are never reached. C80 is a successful local-only control; C150 joint service witness is an exact old qualified input, not a newly discovered solution.
